hook.hook: This Changes Everything About India's Future.

scenes.title: Prime Minister's 75th Independence Day Speech
scenes.key_idea: Developed India became a national objective
scenes.key_insight: The vision was announced during the 75th Independence Day speech.
scenes.important_quote: We should prepare for the next 25 years.
scenes.learning_outcome: Understand where the Developed India vision originated.
scenes.voiceover: This changes everything about India's future.

scenes.title: NITI Aayog's Six-Month Initiative
scenes.purpose: Explain how the roadmap was created
scenes.key_idea: NITI Aayog coordinated the development blueprint
scenes.key_insight: Multiple stakeholders contributed to a national development framework.
scenes.important_quote: A large number of people were involved in giving input.
scenes.learning_outcome: Learn how long-term national planning is executed.
scenes.voiceover: India's strategic roadmap to become a developed nation by 2047 is no longer a dream.

scenes.title: Infrastructure Expansion
scenes.key_insight: National highways expanded significantly across the country.
scenes.learning_outcome: Understand the role of infrastructure in economic development.
scenes.voiceover: From highways to logistics corridors, India is building the future.

scenes.title: Digital Transformation
scenes.key_idea: Digital transformation became a core development pillar
scenes.key_insight: India digitized citizen services at unprecedented scale.
scenes.important_quote: Digital transformation changed how government works.
scenes.learning_outcome: Understand the importance of digital public infrastructure.
scenes.voiceover: Digital transformation is changing how India works.

scenes.title: Poverty Reduction Programs
scenes.key_insight: PDS and MNREGA improved livelihoods at scale.
scenes.important_quote: Poverty reduction requires focused social interventions.
scenes.learning_outcome: Learn how welfare programs contribute to development.
scenes.voiceover: Millions have moved out of poverty through focused intervention.

scenes.title: 25-Year Strategic Pathway
scenes.key_insight: India's transformation is being planned through 2047.
scenes.important_quote: The next 25 years will define India's future.
scenes.learning_outcome: Understand the timeline behind Developed India.
scenes.voiceover: The roadmap spans a transformational 25-year journey.

scenes.title: Rapid Implementation of Social Schemes
scenes.key_idea: Programs were implemented at speed and scale
scenes.learning_outcome: Learn how execution drives development outcomes.
scenes.voiceover: India has demonstrated the ability to execute at scale.

scenes.title: Future Vision
scenes.key_idea: India aims to become a developed nation by 2047
scenes.key_insight: Economic growth, infrastructure and inclusion will drive progress.
scenes.important_quote: Developed India is not a dream—it is a mission.
scenes.learning_outcome: Understand the end goal of the national vision.
scenes.voiceover: By 2047, India aims to stand among the world's developed nations.
